bio: With over a decade of distinguished experience in Bangalore’s premium real estate landscape, Naveed Ahmed Shaikh stands as a trusted name in the luxury and ultra-luxury housing segment. His vision, refined expertise, and unwavering integrity have positioned him as a leading advisor for clients seeking exclusivity, value, and long-term growth in their investments.

Before establishing Naverah Assets Pvt Ltd, Naveed built his foundation with some of the most reputed names in the industry — Embassy Group, GM Infinite, and Mantri Developers. During his tenure at Embassy Group as Sales Manager, he earned acclaim for his ability to curate premium experiences, build deep client relationships, and close high-value transactions with finesse.

Coming from a strong real estate lineage, Naveed blends strategic market insight with a personalized advisory approach, ensuring that every client discovers not just a property, but a lifestyle investment that reflects their aspirations and success.

At Naverah Assets, he leads with a clear vision — to elevate real estate advisory into an art of trust, transparency, and excellence. With his refined sense of quality and keen eye for opportunity, Naveed guides clients toward the finest investments, offering a seamless and sophisticated experience from consultation to completion.

about: Naverah Assets Private Limited — your trusted partner in every step of your real estate journey. As a RERA-registered channel partner, we are committed to bridging the gap between developers and investors, offering exceptional opportunities in the dynamic real estate sector. With over a decade of industry expertise, our Director brings deep market insight and practical experience to help clients make confident and informed investment decisions.

At Naverah Assets, we believe that finding your dream property is more than just a transaction — it’s a meaningful step toward building a brighter and more secure future. Whether you’re looking for a plot, villa, row house, apartment, or independent home, we provide transparent, reliable, and personalized real estate solutions tailored to your unique needs. Let us guide you in transforming your real estate aspirations into reality. Naverah Assets Private Limited — Your Partner in Property.

The Meaning Behind “Naverah” Naverah is formed by blending the name Naveed, meaning “Bringer of Good News” in Persian, with RAH from the name Sarah, where RAH signifies a “Path” or “Way” in Arabic. Together, Naverah becomes a symbol of guidance, positivity, and success — representing the right path forward. This perfectly reflects our mission to provide trustworthy real estate opportunities and serve as a guiding force in helping clients achieve growth, smart investments, and long-term prosperity.
